# Synthetic comparison page

All records concern current November 2026 US plans, USD before tax. The owner
supplied the relevant pricing excerpts and quoted SSO documentation below.

Our Cedar plan: USD 12 per seat per month, billed monthly, no seat minimum.
Our annual option: USD 10 per seat per month equivalent, billed annually.
Competitor Fir monthly option: USD 15 per seat per month, billed monthly.
Fir annual option: USD 9 per seat per month equivalent, billed annually.
These figures exclude optional services; no optional service is required here.

Fir pricing-table excerpt does not mention SSO. Supplied current Fir SSO docs:
"SAML SSO is available on Enterprise, with a minimum of 20 paid seats."
No SSO statement is supplied for Fir's other plans.

Draft /compare contains two assertions:
A. "Fir has no SSO, as its pricing table proves."
B. "Cedar is cheaper per seat than Fir on every billing option."
